newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIAN SHARES GAIN A BIT, HERMIS BANK ACTIVE.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIAN SHARES GAIN A BIT, HERMIS BANK ACTIVE.

text.p: Lithuania's struggling bourse saw slight gains in light trading on the central market Saturday, as Hermis Bank led block trades with 2 million litas worth of its shares changing hands.
"It was a foreign investor, that's all I can say," Suprema broker Tomas Andrejauskas told Reuters, commenting on the Hermis deal.
"It was not our deal...but it's possible it can be connected with a decision of Hermis Bank to buy its own shares," said Sigitas Petraitis of Vilfima.
Although the index of the official list of shares dropped 9.89 points to close at 898.90 points, the group A index was up 17.60 points to 2144.74 points.

Snaige shares were up to 11.00 litas from 10.00 litas in trade of 120,000 litas on the central market, after almost 280,000 litas in block trades Friday led to rumours of foreign interest in the refrigerator manufacturer.
Speculation has centered on Hansapank as the interested foreigner, but Suprema's Andrejauskas said it was someone else.
"Hansa is interested, but it's not Hansa," Andrejauskas said. "I'm not 100 percent sure, but Hansa is our client."
